# I9
Verdict: reject
CRITICAL: 0
MAJOR: 1
Headline: Observation-matched history selection remains distinct, but its independent research value over existing history-aware recovery training is insufficiently supported (candidate.json; prior_work.md).
Occupation: Sequence Model Imitation Learning with Unobserved Contexts covers the connection between demonstration histories, learner deviations and failed recovery. IntervenGen covers intervention-data generation and recovery using failed-grasp feedback when identical observed poses conceal different geometries. The residual is I9's explicit observation-matched history-selection criterion; the supplied record does not establish that this criterion is occupied (candidate.json; prior_work.md: Sequence Model and IntervenGen entries).
Experiment: The proposed 2,000 pairs, 500 unseen trials, validation-selected augmentation/intervention controls, transition/failure matching and below-three-point kill threshold form a bounded comparative test. The decisive comparison is against capable intervention training, concretely represented by IntervenGen's BC-RNN with its informative recovery observations; the ten-point expectation supplies no result (candidate.json; prior_work.md).
Estimand: Recovery improvement attributable to the selection criterion is the appropriate residual estimand. Matched counts and shuffled history–action assignments provide relevant controls, but a loss under shuffling would establish dependence on that association without demonstrating an advantage over existing history-aware intervention training. The proposed intervention-data comparison must carry that claim (candidate.json; prior_work.md: IntervenGen).
Payoff: Conflicting recovery labels at the same current observation establish that current observation alone is insufficient. This gives the selection rule a concrete interpretation, but IntervenGen already demonstrates recovery in that situation using historical feedback. The packet does not identify a remaining limitation of that approach that explicit pair selection resolves, or supply an argument for an additional information, resource or recovery advantage. This missing support concerns the residual contribution, rather than the established importance of recovery data (candidate.json; prior_work.md).
Feasibility: The stated two-A100 fine-tuning budget and 500-trial evaluation describe a bounded first-paper attempt. Data-generation feasibility remains conditional on realizing the proposed 2,000 pairs; the supplied record establishes no resource impossibility (candidate.json).
History: unavailable; no verified history summary was supplied.
Assessment: {"coverage":"not-covered","coverage_evidence":[{"source":"candidate","quote":"Summary: Generate observation-matched histories whose correct recovery actions differ."},{"source":"prior-work","quote":"It selects recoveries by intervention generation, rather than an explicit observation-matched history-identifiability criterion."}],"causes":[{"code":"value-insufficient","evidence":[{"source":"candidate","quote":"Why It May Be Novel: History identifiability as a data selection criterion requires directed verification."},{"source":"candidate","quote":"Expect 10-point recovery gain; kill below 3 points over intervention data."},{"source":"prior-work","quote":"The nut-geometry task has identical observed poses with different hidden geometries; failed-grasp feedback enables recovery."},{"source":"prior-work","quote":"Table II gives mixture success of 90% for I-Gen versus 62% for Base + MG Demo, a difference of 28 percentage points; this is not a transition-count-matched estimate of the effect of informative histories."}]}]
Reason: Reject with one MAJOR finding: the independently valuable payoff of explicit history-identifiability selection is unsupported. The supplied argument motivates informative recovery histories, which the closest intervention method already exploits, but does not establish why explicit pairing adds a research contribution beyond that capability. The distinct construction and executable comparative outline therefore do not yet meet either positive recommendation's value requirement. The finding concerns missing support for the residual value; the absence of completed experiments is not itself a defect (candidate.json; prior_work.md).
